description: TrilaWatt Use-Case: Neue Werkzeuge und Daten zur Trassierung von Kabeln und Pipelines im Wattenmeer is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. TrilaWatt data and analysis products can be used to study the trajectory of structures, such as power cables, on or under the seabed. The implementation of a trajectory shall include the examination of the geological, ecological and hydrodynamic characteristics of the area and the assessment of potential risks. Coverage: Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. The portal shows the English title as "TrilaWatt Use Case: New tools and data for tracing cables and pipelines in the Wadden Sea" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Bundesanstalt für Wasserbau. Its keywords include waddensea, Schelfmeer, Topographie, bathymetry, estuary, mFUND-Projekt:TrilaWatt. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
